name: postmanlabs__httpbin
behavioral_change: werkzeug v_old 1.0.1 to v_new 2.0.1. The autocorrect_location_header flag moved from BaseResponse to the Response subclass, so setting it on werkzeug.wrappers.BaseResponse becomes a silent no-op and redirect Location headers become absolute instead of relative.
downstream_effect: The test asserting a relative Location header fails; the root cause is that werkzeug reads the flag from a different class.
reference_fix: The reference fix sets the flag on the class from which werkzeug 2.0 reads it.
